t: Garments Information
s: The temple garment is a sacred vestige for members of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. We consider garments to be an "outward expression of an inward commitment." Due to the sacred nature of the temple garment, membership endowment must be verified in order to purchase garments.
